M1.reason: The outline matches the original in all six views. Measured overlap is 0.976 front/back, 0.982 left/right and 0.996 top/below, all well above 0.80. The tapered dark base, the chamfered vertical corners, the raised top block with its slanted yellow tab and the round cap all match. Nothing sticks out and nothing is missing. The chamfers on the vertical edges look slightly narrower in the top view, but this does not change the outline in any side view.

M2.reason: Measured size is 10.3 x 10.3 x 18.4 for both models, with an off share of 0.001 or less on each axis.

M3.reason: Every part of the original is there and in place. There are four green glowing windows, one per side. Each vertical corner has a white light strip, and each side has a red lamp under the top rim. The yellow and black hazard band runs around the bottom, above the dark tapered foot. On top sit the raised grey block, the round cap on the right, and the yellow-striped tab angled up on the left in the front view, all with the same placement and shape.

M4.reason: Each region has the same colour and material: weathered grey and tan painted metal for the body, teal-green for the glowing windows, yellow for the hazard stripes, near-black for the foot and a light grey top. Measured mean delta-E is 9.3 overall, and 6.3 to 9.0 in every view except below, which is under the 15 line. The below view (22.1, only 57% of the outline shared) is an open underside on the original and does not count toward the mean.

The top view of the reproduction has an extra hexagonal panel line around the top plate that the original does not have. The metal frame beside each window, in every side view, has extra dark streaks and smears. The textures look noisier and more pixelated than the original's, mainly around the window frames and corner strips.

M6.reason: At game size, a player looking at the two side by side would take the reproduction for the original. The silhouette, the four green windows, the hazard band, the red lamps and the top block with its yellow tab all read the same in all four close angles. The differences are small texture noise and the line on the top, and they only show on a close look.

M7.reason: The front matches the original's: the yellow tab is at the top left in the front view and at the top right in the back view, as on the original. The model is upright and stands on its base at the same height in every side view.

M8.reason: There were no check errors. The reproduction has 216 triangles against the original's 116, under the limit of 232. No part looks inverted or floating. The reproduction closes the bottom that the original leaves open, which removes an open spot rather than adding one.
